title: KillLiveProcesses leaves a live runner's detached tools running too
description:
The fixture/reconcile teardown helper (internal/exec/subprocess/lock.go, KillLiveProcesses) SIGKILLs only the process groups the attempt's locks prove are alive. A detached tool group under a live runner is in none of those groups, so a teardown of an attempt with a hung tool still orphans it — the same defect this tick fixed on the supervisor and cancel stops, on the path test fixtures use on this shared host. A small fix now exists to copy: interrupt the detached groups under the live runner locks before the kill loop.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/lock.go:325 (KillLiveProcesses signals only stopProven's lock-proven groups); the interrupt seam it would reuse is interrupt.go interruptToolGroups
